| linprog | ◐ | ◐ | dense simplex; practical to a few thousand rows — `LP::linprog` `XE::linprog` |
| milp | ◐ | ◐ | dense branch and bound — `LP::milp` `XE::milp` |
| HiGHS for large sparse LP/MILP | — | — |  |
| linear_sum_assignment / nnls / lsq_linear | ◐ | — | lsq_linear unbounded only — `ASG::linearSumAssignment` `LS::nnls` `LS::lsqLinear` |
| global: differential_evolution, basinhopping, dual_annealing, shgo | — | — |  |
| approx_fprime | ● | — | `Min::approxGrad` |
